name: vwg-dispatcher-backend
description: Cloudflare Worker and D1 foundation for VWG Dispatcher 2.0

scripts.check: node --check src/index.mjs && node --check src/auth.mjs && node --check src/audit.mjs && node --check src/crypto.mjs
scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply vwg-dispatcher-foundation --local --config wrangler.toml
scripts.migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply vwg-dispatcher-foundation --remote --config wrangler.toml
